_comment: Gate 2 per spec 3.4 thresholds as amended by 3.6 (2026-08-15): a reliability gate, not an improvement gate. The bare arm is dropped everywhere except c12, because with the skill uninstalled it measures the model rather than the gate; on the anti-triggers it measures less still, since only the implicit arm can exhibit the failure under test. Reps are untouched — 3/3 is the reliability claim. Anti-triggers c07/c08 run implicit only: explicit invocation on a lookup tests nothing about firing, and bare tests nothing about the skill. 65 runs per harness, 130 across claude and codex, inside the 144 predeclared in 3.5. Cases 11-14 were added after the Gate 2 bare-arm screen; see results/gate2-screen/README.md for why 11, 13 and 14 are kept on coverage rather than headroom.
